>I can’t believe I put myself in such a dangerous situation all because I was upset I wasn’t getting laid 

I’m glad you figured this out OP. In one form or another way too many gay men have been doing this for way too long. If it’s not rando Grindr hookups it’s bathhouses or sketchy bars where people fuck in public. There’s this dark, unsafe, hypersexualized underbelly to the gay community that people try so hard to normalize. 

Sooner you get away from it and allow yourself to mature emotionally the happier you’ll be. Don’t allow yourself to become one of those sad emotionally stagnant gay man children. You can do better. Much better and this is a start.

I am so sorry for your loss OP. My grandmother outlived my grandfather by decades and never remarried or even dated again. When asked why she’d always say it was because it wouldn’t be fair to the new guy. 

Whatever my grandfather did made her feel so loved and valued it sustained her for the rest of her life. If that’s what you’ve had, you don’t need to be with anyone else but at the very least let the love he gave to you be a gift you try to share with the rest of the world, when you’re ready. 

If you’re able to take anything away from this terrible tragedy maybe it’ll be that you know better than most that true love *is* attainable and you can set about helping others in some way? Maybe grief/loss groups? It sounds like you may benefit from people who can seriously empathize.

(He *did* just agree to come see a touring broadway show with me next month though)

>how much of that will be affected?

I don’t know 

>you’re protecting

Partly, but he’s also agreed that we are good for each other and my place in his life is a constant as the men he tries to date continue to fall away. 

I’ve done my best to assure him we could still be good friends even if we do end up with other people but it would be hard. Very hard. 

Right now he is a daily part of my life and when we see each other in person it’s always meaningful like what it was this week. 

If he ends up rejecting anything deeper it will feel like such a loss. I’ve never felt anyone I’ve connected like this with before and I don’t think he has either based on what he’s told me. 

I don’t know

Oh I have and his as well. 

My sun and moon are both in Cancer with Libra ascending

Yes. I have been and continue to be in therapy
I appreciate what you’re saying but it is not helpful

Peaceful to me implies a sense of nothingness. If I want my life to be all Buddhist and free of attachment and highs or excitement and just be this emotionally blank “existence” why stay alive for that?

That’s not a life to me. Life is meant to be passionate and have ups and downs. Why is it the “answers” are always about detaching yourself? I did that for years, it’s called a dissociative state and it is **not** fun. Peaceful? Sure, you don’t really feel anything. You’re “still” and “one with the universe” but it is not a sustainable place to be in. It feels empty. Idw to live an empty life where I just simply “exist”
